summary: Transcode proxy bang GPU Intel (QuickSync qua VAAPI) tren NAS Intel: nhanh hon va do ton CPU hon nhieu so voi libx264.
changes: Neu NAS da cai goi FFmpeg 7 cua SynoCommunity (kem SynoCli Video Driver), Coopeditor tu dung ffmpeg do thay cho ban ffmpeg tinh di kem (ban nay chi chay CPU).
Goi khai bao video-driver giong Plex: DSM tu cho user coopeditor vao nhom videodriver de duoc dung /dev/dri/renderD128.

Bat GPU: dat "hwaccel": "vaapi" trong muc transcode cua var/conf/runtime-config.json. Worker tu kiem tra GPU luc khoi dong, loi thi quay ve CPU libx264; trang Cai dat hien worker dang dung vaapi hay CPU.
Gom luon ban sua cua rc66: khong con transcode lai ca thu vien moi lan khoi dong.
